> - Roadmap freeze: I can finalize...

Heads-up on the latency exception: during the last perf sweep we saw a 12-18% tail latency bump on long-context workloads when the new KV-cache refactor is enabled with batch sizes >= 8. Impact assessment so far: some enterprise routes with high concurrency (Acme included) could exceed our 99th percentile SLO under current pool sizing.

Planned mitigation:
- Short window rollback of the refactor on dedicated pools (2 hours) if we see sustained SLO breach during smoke tests (owner: infra-oncall)
- Temporary autoscale bump for affected pools during ramp (owner: infra/ops)
- Longer term: tune kernel selection path to favor smaller batch sizes for long-context models (owner: performance eng)

I'll draft the exception writeup and severity note — will drop a short blurb for the exec slide by 3/10 12pm. Question for Kimberly: does the retention note need to reference any capacity/egress cost impact for Acme or is a compliance-only statement sufficient?

--
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Serving Runtime
